verdicts.rationale: c1 is a vendor claim that Entity Management integrates with enterprise and third-party systems 'via modern APIs', but the coverage check found no public API documentation for the entity management or registered agent product, only DomainManager docs for a different product.
verdicts.missing: Public API documentation for this product; which core records (entities, filings, SOP documents) the API reads or changes; and whether customers can call it directly and how access is granted. The only API evidence is one marketing sentence.

verdicts.rationale: No item in the pack mentions an MCP server for the product.
verdicts.missing: Any official MCP server, who maintains it, what it covers, or setup steps.

verdicts.rationale: No item mentions an official CLI, SDK, package-registry listing or public code repository.
verdicts.missing: Any vendor-maintained CLI or SDK on a public registry or repository, or even code samples.

verdicts.rationale: No item mentions webhooks, event subscriptions or any change notifications an agent could subscribe to instead of polling.
verdicts.missing: Documented webhooks or event subscriptions for entities, filings or SOP documents, or any events offered through a third-party automation platform.

verdicts.rationale: No item mentions API keys, OAuth clients, tokens, or scopes and roles that limit what a credential can do.
verdicts.missing: How API credentials are issued and whether scopes, roles or permissions can limit them.

verdicts.rationale: No item shows an OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL or other machine-readable spec, and the coverage check found no public API documentation for this product.
verdicts.missing: Any machine-readable API specification for this product, public or behind a login.

verdicts.rationale: The coverage check found no public documentation or help center for the registered agent or entity management product, and no item shows an llms.txt file or Markdown pages.
verdicts.missing: An llms.txt file or Markdown versions of documentation pages, and public documentation for this product at all.

verdicts.rationale: No item mentions a sandbox, test mode or developer environment, whether self-serve or on request.
verdicts.missing: Any sandbox, test mode or developer environment and how to get access to it.

verdicts.rationale: c5 claims only centralized access to entity data, filings and compliance status, and no item mentions exporting or downloading records in bulk in any format.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve bulk export or download of entity, filing or SOP records, and the formats offered.

verdicts.rationale: No item shows a self-serve sign-up or free trial, and the coverage check found only contact-us links on the registered agent page.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve sign-up, free trial or paid plan a sponsor can start without contacting sales.

verdicts.rationale: c2 claims 'one flat fee' but shows no amount, and the coverage check found no prices on the registered agent page, only contact-us links.
verdicts.missing: Any published price, fee or starting price for entity management or registered agent service.

verdicts.rationale: c3 describes generating documents through a guided workflow that routes signatures via Docusign and c1 makes only a generic integration-API claim, so nothing shows an agent can start a filing or other core transaction through an API or partner integration.
verdicts.missing: API documentation showing filings, document generation or other core transactions can be created programmatically, even as drafts or through a partner integration.

verdicts.rationale: c4 and c5 claim SOP document tracking and centralized access to filing and compliance status, but neither shows an API, structured feed or email notice that returns status.
verdicts.missing: A documented API or structured feed returning the status of filings, orders or SOP documents, or even status email notices.

verdicts.rationale: c4 and c5 claim same-day SOP document delivery and centralized access to filings, but neither shows an API that returns finished documents or says documents arrive as emailed download links.
verdicts.missing: A documented API returning filed documents, SOP scans or other finished records, or download links sent by email.
